comics.alt: Rumor has it that they're finally auctioning off the zeppelin navigation bands, but everyone is worried that the scary boat captains will express interest.

comics.title: Accelerator Energies
comics.alt: Fans at Daytona always get extra excited when officials decide to introduce some antimatter cars circling the track in the opposite direction.

comics.title: Ground Effect
comics.alt: Runners looking for aerodynamic advantage typically wear sneakers because some fancy dress shoes can create wingtip vortices.

comics.title: Jupiter Icy Moons Explorer
comics.alt: "I did briefly visit Venus in August 2025, but I figured out the mistake on my own because it didn't have any moons."

comics.title: Slab Graveyard
comics.alt: It's ok if you want to close close your eyes for the slab graveyard, so you can still have fun riding the mantle plume back up afterward!

comics.title: Voyager Instruments
comics.alt: Convincing him to turn off the stupid laser show and useless sound system was such a huge ordeal that no one has wanted to do it again.

comics.title: Stargazing 5
comics.alt: The sun and the moon appear the same size in the sky, even though in real life the sun is more than twice as big. Some call this lucky alignment coincidence; others say it's proof that sometimes things can be the same size.

comics.title: Tyrannosaurus
comics.alt: Many of the smaller dinosaurs seem to have largely preyed on housecats.

comics.title: Summer
comics.alt: You should probably get back to shore before spring hits.

comics.alt: Someday, we will find the problem that goes with this solution.

comics.title: OH Scale
comics.alt: To access distant parts of the project, I ended up building a regular-scale passenger train inside each rail.

comics.title: Fault Taunting
comics.alt: One of the first things they teach you is to NEVER play with the geology toy over a mantle hotspot.

comics.title: Semaphore
comics.alt: The speed of light in air is 50% faster than in fiber, but it's a challenge to get the arms to move fast enough to realize the latency advantage.

comics.title: Asteroid Mission
comics.alt: Lander, this is Houston. There's been a request that you turn clipping back on and instead set the mass to 1kg. The theorists believe that will be pretty funny.

comics.title: Handedness

comics.title: Launchpad
comics.alt: It does come at the cost of some launchpad expansions and increased fuel requirements, but that all comes out of the facility's budget.

comics.title: Trade
comics.alt: "You legs may have a comparative advantage at running, but we arms have a competitive advantage at swinging hammers, so unless you accept that we're the dominant limbs and stop hogging the oxygen, that running advantage won't be around for long."

comics.title: Highway Signs
comics.alt: Highway engineers like Planck units because, like the speed of light, the energy capacity of a typical car's gas tank is 1.
